summary: Validated iTRAIN v3 multi-control evaluations (backend + frontend). Backend pytest suite: 29/29 passed covering route ordering, multi-control CRUD, /list/timeline/by-id, share public access, template CRUD, legacy coexistence. Frontend E2E: login -> Datos -> Plan Test API -> Evaluación -> Control Médico -> all data-testids present, save, Enlace button copies share URL to clipboard with 'Enlace copiado al portapapeles' toast, history chips render (2), delete-btn visible with activeId. Plan Gráfico renders all 8 Monitoreo rows (Control médico, Antropometría, Control físico, Biomecánica, Control técnico, Control táctico, Control psicológico, Control teórico).

issues: React hydration warnings: the visual-editor debug wrapper <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> is being inserted as a direct child of <tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td>, which is invalid HTML. critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in /app/backend/routes/evaluations_export.py is correctly declared specific-before-catchall (lines 241, 272, 288, 316, 337, 392, 466, 499). Verified by both test_templates_returns_templates_shape and test_catchall_returns_aspects_shape passing for all 8 eval types.

Public shared endpoints (GET /shared/{id} and /shared/{id}/pdf) have no auth dependency - HTTP 200 without Bearer token confirmed.

rca of the issue: Previous iteration bug (Enlace button not working + route ordering collision) was caused by FastAPI matching catch-all /{plan_id}/{evaluation_type} before specific routes like /templates/{type}, /shared/{id}, /by-id/{id}. Main agent's fix: reorder @router decorators so all specific routes come BEFORE the catch-all GET (line 499 now last). Verified end-to-end: templates endpoint no longer hijacked, shared endpoint reachable without auth, Enlace button produces valid share URL and copies to clipboard.
